Market today: Tech and AI names are seeing a strong boost today, with Salesforce and CrowdStrike jumping on robust earnings and AI narratives. This provides a positive tailwind for your concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings: SOXL is a deep concern, down over 54% and leveraged. SPAL, another leveraged ETF, is also down significantly at -40% and new. Remember, margin amplifies these drops. CRWD is up 5% but on a TRIM status, while SMH and QQQI are also marked TRIM with losses.

Watch: Keep a very close eye on SOXL and SPAL's price action given their leveraged nature and deep losses. Consider tightening stops or re-evaluating these positions. For CRWD, watch for continued strength to execute your trim.

Bottom line: Aggressively manage your leveraged losers and trim into strength on your winners.
plays: SOXL: This leveraged ETF is down over 54% and marked SELL. Re-evaluate your position and consider a hard stop or exit to protect capital.
SPAL: Another leveraged ETF, down over 40% and new. This needs immediate attention; consider a hard stop or exit.
CRWD: Trim into today's 11% jump, respecting your 147.5 stop.
